4649.en: An artist-run gallery in Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, on the second floor of a small building. It presents contemporary art exhibitions and also takes part in art fairs and off-site projects. Shinjuku is one of Tokyo's busiest districts, with a wide mix of shops, offices and cultural venues.
4649.ja: 新宿区新宿にある、アーティストが運営するギャラリー。小さなビルの2階で現代美術の展覧会を開催するほか、アートフェアや外部での企画にも参加している。

10-chancery-lane-gallery.en: 10 Chancery Lane Gallery is a contemporary art gallery in the SoHo area of Central, founded in 2001. It presents artists from Asia and Southeast Asia, and supports emerging Hong Kong artists through its HKFOREWORD series.

13a-new-street-art-gallery.en: 13A New Street Art Gallery is a gallery and event space in Tai Ping Shan. It stages joint exhibitions, talks, events, and workshops, and supports local and overseas artists and emerging talent. Tai Ping Shan is a historic neighbourhood in Sheung Wan, close to Hollywood Road.

18-murata.en: A small contemporary art gallery in Futaba, Shinagawa-ku, in the Oimachi area. It presents a changing programme of contemporary art exhibitions. Oimachi is a residential and commercial neighbourhood in the south of Tokyo, away from the main gallery districts.
18-murata.ja: 品川区二葉、大井町エリアにある小さな現代美術のギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を入れ替えながら開催する。大井町は、都内南部の住宅と商業が混在するエリア。

21-21-design-sight.en: A design museum in Tokyo Midtown Garden in Akasaka, Minato-ku, housed in a building designed by Tadao Ando. It works as a research centre for design and presents exhibitions on design themes across its galleries. The Midtown complex around it also includes shops, restaurants and green space.
21-21-design-sight.ja: 港区赤坂の東京ミッドタウン・ガーデンにある、安藤忠雄設計のデザイン施設。デザインを考え、リサーチする場として、複数のギャラリーでデザインをテーマにした展覧会を開いている。

abeno-harukas-art-museum.en: An urban art museum on the 16th floor of the Abeno Harukas tower in Abeno-ku, Osaka, conceived as a place where anyone can enjoy art and culture casually. It presents rotating exhibitions near the Tennoji transport hub.
abeno-harukas-art-museum.ja: 大阪・阿倍野区のあべのハルカス16階にある「都市型美術館」。誰もが気軽に芸術・文化を楽しめる場を掲げ、さまざまな展覧会を開催している。天王寺のターミナルに隣接する。

anomaly-tokyo.en: A contemporary art gallery on the fourth floor of TERRADA Art Complex I in Higashi-Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku. It presents a series of exhibitions in the Tennozu gallery district, in the same building as several other galleries.
anomaly-tokyo.ja: 品川区東品川、TERRADA Art Complex I 4階にある現代アートのギャラリー。複数のギャラリーが入る建物で、天王洲のギャラリーエリアで展覧会を続けて開催する。

art-and-space-gallery.en: A genre-free art gallery in Tenjinbashi, Kita-ku, Osaka. It is conceived as a place to encounter the worlds and messages that artists create, and holds exhibitions of a wide range of work. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
art-and-space-gallery.ja: 大阪・北区天神橋にある、ジャンルを問わない作品を扱うアートギャラリー。作家の世界やメッセージに触れる場を目指し、幅広い作品の展覧会を開催している。

art-collaboration-kyoto.en: A contemporary art fair held at the Kyoto International Conference Center in Takaragaike, Sakyo-ku. Galleries from Japan and abroad take part, with an emphasis on collaboration between them, in a lakeside area of northern Kyoto.
art-collaboration-kyoto.ja: 京都国際会館（左京区宝ヶ池）で開かれる現代アートのフェア。国内外のギャラリーが参加し、ギャラリー同士の連携を軸に構成される。会場は京都北部の池のほとりにある。

art-gallery-kitano.en: A rental gallery on Sanjo-dori near the Sanjo-Kawaramachi crossing in Nakagyo-ku. Its concept is encounters with the unknown, and it is set up to be easy for passers-by to enter. Exhibitions change regularly in the heart of central Kyoto.
art-gallery-kitano.ja: 中京区、三条河原町の交差点近くの三条通沿いにあるレンタルギャラリー。「未知との出会い」をコンセプトに、通りがかりにも入りやすい雰囲気をめざしている。

art-rhizome-kyoto.en: A contemporary art festival held across Kyoto, with programmes spread over several sites rather than a single central venue. Each edition brings together exhibitions and related events, so visitors move between locations around the city.
art-rhizome-kyoto.ja: 京都市内の複数の会場で開かれる現代アートの祭典。中心となる会場は持たず、展覧会や関連企画が各所で展開される。会期ごとに、街の中を巡りながら作品に触れられる構成となっている。

artcourt-gallery.en: A gallery on the ground floor of the OAP Art Court building in Tenmabashi, Kita-ku, Osaka. It is a dealer mainly handling contemporary art, and holds exhibitions of works by contemporary artists. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
artcourt-gallery.ja: 大阪・北区天満橋のOAPアートコート1階にある、現代美術作品を主に扱う画廊。現代作家の作品を紹介する展示を開催している。

artizon-museum.en: A museum in Kyobashi, Chuo-ku, run by the Ishibashi Foundation and continuing the legacy of the former Bridgestone Museum of Art. It shows works from its collection alongside special exhibitions across several floors. Kyobashi sits close to Ginza and Tokyo Station, among offices and galleries.
artizon-museum.ja: 中央区京橋にある、石橋財団が運営する美術館。旧ブリヂストン美術館の流れをくみ、所蔵作品の展示と企画展を複数のフロアで行う。銀座や東京駅にも近い、オフィスとギャラリーが並ぶエリアにある。

artro.en: A contemporary art gallery in Kaiya-cho, Nakagyo-ku. It stages exhibitions of contemporary artists, and a cafe at the entrance leads visitors into the gallery space, in the centre of Kyoto. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is open to visitors.
artro.ja: 中京区貝屋町にある現代アートのギャラリー。現代作家の企画展を開いており、入口にはカフェが設けられている。京都の中心部に位置する。

arts-science-kyoto.en: The Kyoto shop of the select shop and brand ARTS&SCIENCE, located in Nakagyo-ku. Alongside retail it hosts events and displays, drawing on design and everyday objects. It is in central Kyoto and hosts changing displays throughout the year.
arts-science-kyoto.ja: セレクトショップ・ブランドARTS&SCIENCEの京都の店舗で、中京区にある。販売のほか、デザインや暮らしの道具に関わる催しや展示も行っている。

asia-art-archive.en: Asia Art Archive is an independent art institute on Hollywood Road in Sheung Wan. It documents and researches contemporary art in Asia and holds a public library and archive. Its programmes include occasional exhibitions alongside talks and research projects.

asia-society-hong-kong.en: Asia Society Hong Kong Center is a cultural institute in Admiralty, on Justice Drive. It combines an exhibition space with talks and public programmes. Its gallery programme centres on contemporary art, often with an Asian focus.

atelier-muji-ginza.en: A small gallery in Ginza, Chuo-ku, operated by Muji. It holds exhibitions centred on design, daily goods and lifestyle themes. The gallery sits in Ginza's shopping district, an area known for department stores, boutiques and other galleries.
atelier-muji-ginza.ja: 中央区銀座にある、無印良品が運営する小さなギャラリー。デザインや日用品、暮らしにまつわるテーマの展示を行う。百貨店やブティック、ギャラリーが集まる銀座の商業エリアに位置する。

ben-brown.en: Ben Brown Fine Arts is a gallery with a Hong Kong space presenting modern and contemporary art. Its exhibitions cover artists from Europe, Asia and elsewhere, with a programme of solo and group shows. The gallery also operates internationally from several locations.

blindspot-gallery.en: Blindspot Gallery is a contemporary art gallery on the 15th floor of an industrial building in Wong Chuk Hang. It represents and exhibits contemporary artists, many from Asia, with a particular interest in photography-based work. Its programme is built around exhibitions in the district's gallery cluster.

blue-lotus-gallery.en: Blue Lotus Gallery is a photography gallery in Hong Kong. It works with a roster of photographers and offers viewing rooms and books, with much of the work depicting Hong Kong and other Asian urban and architectural subjects.

chushin-bijutsu.en: A museum in Kamigyo-ku run by Kyoto Chuo Shinkin Bank. It shows exhibitions of artists connected to the bank and its art foundation, to support and pass on Kyoto's art and culture. Exhibitions change regularly throughout the year.
chushin-bijutsu.ja: 上京区にある、京都中央信用金庫が運営する美術館。同金庫や中信美術奨励基金に関わる作家の作品展を開き、京都の芸術文化の振興と継承を目指している。

con-tokyo.en: A gallery that opened in 2022 on the east side of Tokyo, in Nihonbashi-Bakurocho, Chuo-ku. Its programme focuses on visuality and concept, crossing various expressive cultures including contemporary art. Bakurocho is an old wholesale district with a growing number of galleries.
con-tokyo.ja: 2022年に東京東部の中央区日本橋馬喰町で開廊したギャラリー。視覚性とコンセプトを軸に、現代美術を含むさまざまな表現文化を横断するプログラムを組む。

congres-square-grand-green-osaka.en: An event and exhibition space on the fourth floor of the Grand Green Osaka South Building in Ofuka-cho, Kita-ku. It hosts fairs, exhibitions and related events, in the redeveloped area beside Osaka Station. Events change regularly.
congres-square-grand-green-osaka.ja: 大阪・北区大深町のグラングリーン大阪 南館4階にあるイベント・展示スペース。展示会やフェアなどを開催する。大阪駅北側の再開発エリアに位置する。

contemporary-by-angela-li.en: Contemporary by Angela Li is a Hong Kong gallery focused on contemporary art. It presents solo exhibitions by local and regional artists, and also takes part in art fairs and offers art consultancy. The gallery's programme centres on artists from Hong Kong and the wider region.

curation-fair-kyoto.en: An art fair held in Kyoto, with exhibitors presenting contemporary works in a curated format. It is based around Myokenji-mae-cho in Kamigyo-ku, and each edition brings together a selection of participating galleries and artists. Visitors can see a variety of work in one place.
curation-fair-kyoto.ja: 京都で開かれる現代アートのフェア。出展者がキュレーションされた形式で作品を紹介する。上京区の妙顕寺前町周辺を拠点とし、会期ごとに複数の出展者が参加する。

curation-fair-tokyo.en: An annual art event that links academic curation with the market-driven art fair, held in two cities, Tokyo and Kyoto. The Tokyo edition takes place in Kudankita, Chiyoda-ku, an area near Kudanshita and the Imperial Palace grounds. The fair brings together galleries and curators.
curation-fair-tokyo.ja: 学術的なキュレーションと市場性のあるアートフェアをつなぐ、東京と京都の2都市で開かれるアートイベント。東京版は千代田区九段北で開かれる。ギャラリーやキュレーターが集まる。

david-zwirner.en: David Zwirner Hong Kong is a contemporary art gallery on the 5th and 6th floors of H Queen's, on Queen's Road Central. It presents solo and group exhibitions of modern and contemporary artists, as part of an international gallery with several locations.

dnp-foundation-for-cultural-promotion-ga.en: A gallery specialising in graphic design, on the third floor of COCON KARASUMA in Shimogyo-ku. It holds exhibitions and lectures, and is one of few graphic design galleries in the Kansai area. Its exhibitions focus on graphic design and related fields.
dnp-foundation-for-cultural-promotion-ga.ja: 下京区のCOCON KARASUMA 3階にある、グラフィックデザイン専門のギャラリー。関西では数少ない同分野のギャラリーとして、展覧会やレクチャーを開いている。

empty-gallery.en: Empty Gallery is a contemporary art gallery in Tin Wan, Aberdeen. It shows and represents artists working across experimental film, sound, digital media, and photography. The gallery also hosts music events and publishes an editions programme.

fukuda-art-museum.en: A museum in Saga-Arashiyama, Ukyo-ku, opened in October 2019. It centres on Nihonga from the Edo period onward, holds about 2,000 works, and shows four themed exhibitions a year. The museum is in the well-known Arashiyama sightseeing area.
fukuda-art-museum.ja: 右京区の嵯峨嵐山にある、2019年10月開館の美術館。江戸時代から近代の日本画を中心に約2000点を所蔵し、年4回の企画展を開いている。

gagosian-hong-kong.en: Gagosian Hong Kong is a contemporary art gallery in Central, part of an international gallery with several locations. It presents exhibitions of modern and contemporary artists in the city's main commercial gallery district, where many galleries share nearby buildings.

galerie-du-monde.en: Galerie du Monde is a gallery at Ruttonjee Centre on Duddell Street in Central. It presents exhibitions of contemporary art and painting, and also publishes and works on conservation. Duddell Street is a short historic street close to the shops and galleries of Central.

galerie16.en: A contemporary art gallery on the third floor of a building in Sekisenin-cho, Higashiyama-ku. It presents a programme of exhibitions of contemporary artists, in a part of Kyoto close to the Kamo River. Exhibitions change regularly.
galerie16.ja: 東山区石泉院町のビル3階にある現代美術ギャラリー。現代作家の展覧会を継続的に開いている。鴨川にも近い、京都の東側のエリアに位置する。

gallery-baiken.en: A contemporary art gallery in Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto. It holds a programme of exhibitions of contemporary art, and its location in central Kyoto makes it easy to combine with other galleries in the district. Its shows change regularly.
gallery-baiken.ja: 京都市中京区にある現代アートのギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を継続的に開催している。京都の中心部にあり、周辺のほかのギャラリーとあわせて訪ねやすい。

gallery-exit.en: Gallery EXIT is a contemporary art gallery on the 3rd floor of an industrial building in Tin Wan, Aberdeen. It presents its artists through solo and group exhibitions and takes part in art fairs. Tin Wan is a southern district of Hong Kong Island with a cluster of galleries.

gallery-morning-kyoto.en: A small gallery in the Higashiyama-ku area of Kyoto that shows exhibitions of contemporary art. Its programme of current and past shows takes place in an area of the city known for its temples and traditional streets.
gallery-morning-kyoto.ja: 京都・東山区にある、現代美術の展覧会を開く小さなギャラリー。寺社や古い街並みで知られる東山エリアにあり、展示を入れ替えながら開催している。

gallery-nomart.en: A gallery in Nagata, Joto-ku, Osaka, run by Nomart Inc. The company's work centres on art, sound and design, under the theme of senses that cross and spread, and the gallery holds exhibitions in that spirit.
gallery-nomart.ja: 大阪・城東区永田にあるギャラリー。運営する株式会社ノマルは、アート・サウンド・デザインを軸にしたものづくりを掲げており、その姿勢に沿った展覧会を開いている。

gallery-take-two.en: A gallery and rental space in Nakagyo-ku, near Kyoto City Hall. It is used for solo and group exhibitions, exhibition sales and workshops. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is in a central part of Kyoto that is easy to reach.
gallery-take-two.ja: 中京区、京都市役所の近くにあるギャラリー兼レンタルスペース。個展やグループ展、展示販売、ワークショップなどに使われている。

gallery-unfold.en: A contemporary art gallery in Jodoji, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto. It holds a changing programme of exhibitions, in a quiet area of the city's east side near the Philosopher's Path. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is open to visitors.
gallery-unfold.ja: 京都市左京区浄土寺にある現代アートのギャラリー。展覧会を入れ替えながら開催している。哲学の道にも近い、市の東側の静かなエリアに位置する。

gallery-yamahon.en: A gallery on the second floor of the Enjudo Minamikan building in Nakagyo-ku, focused on ceramics. It hosts exhibitions of ceramic work in Kyoto, with displays that change over the course of the year. The gallery is in central Kyoto.
gallery-yamahon.ja: 中京区の延寿堂南館2階にある、陶芸を中心としたギャラリー。京都で陶芸作品の展覧会を開催しており、展示は時期ごとに入れ替わる。

ginza-graphic-gallery.en: A gallery in Ginza, Chuo-ku, dedicated to graphic design. Its exhibitions feature designers and related work in the field, presented in a compact exhibition space. Ginza is a shopping district with department stores, boutiques and many other galleries within walking distance.
ginza-graphic-gallery.ja: 中央区銀座にある、グラフィックデザインを専門とするギャラリー。デザイナーや関連分野の作品を紹介する展覧会を開催する。百貨店やギャラリーが多い銀座の商業エリアにあり、周辺の展示と合わせて回りやすい。

grotto-fine-art.en: Grotto Fine Art is a gallery in Shau Kei Wan, on Hong Kong Island. It focuses on contemporary Hong Kong artists working in ink and colour, with a programme of solo and group exhibitions. Shau Kei Wan is a neighbourhood at the eastern end of the island.

gyre-gallery.en: A gallery on the third floor of GYRE, a multipurpose complex along Omotesando in Jingumae, Shibuya-ku. The building combines fashion, design, food and art, and the gallery holds art exhibitions. Omotesando is a tree-lined avenue known for architecture and fashion.
gyre-gallery.ja: 渋谷区神宮前、表参道沿いの複合施設GYREの3階にあるギャラリー。ファッションやデザイン、飲食、アートが集まる施設で、アートの展覧会を開く。建築やファッションの店が並ぶ並木道、表参道にある。

hagiwara-projects.en: A contemporary art gallery on the second floor of the Piramide building in Roppongi, Minato-ku. It presents exhibitions of contemporary artists in a building shared with other galleries. Roppongi is an art district, with several museums and galleries within walking distance.
hagiwara-projects.ja: 港区六本木のピラミデビル2階にある現代美術のギャラリー。同じビルに他のギャラリーが入る建物で、現代美術家の展覧会を開催する。美術館やギャラリーが集まる六本木にある。

hakari-contemporary.en: A contemporary art gallery in the Porte de Okazaki building in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku. It runs a programme of exhibitions, with current and upcoming shows, in Kyoto's museum and park district. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is close to other museums and galleries nearby.
hakari-contemporary.ja: 京都市左京区岡崎、Porte de Okazakiにある現代アートのギャラリー。開催中の展覧会と開催予定の展覧会を順に紹介している。美術館や公園が集まる岡崎エリアに位置する。

hakusasonso.en: A museum and garden in Jodoji, Sakyo-ku, dedicated to the Nihonga painter Hashimoto Kansetsu. It presents his artworks together with the garden he developed over many years, and holds exhibitions in the grounds. It stands in a quiet part of eastern Kyoto.
hakusasonso.ja: 左京区浄土寺にある、日本画家・橋本関雪を記念する美術館と庭園。作品とともに、関雪が長年かけて整えた庭園を公開し、敷地内で展覧会も開かれる。

hanart-tz-gallery.en: Hanart TZ Gallery is a gallery in an industrial building in Kwai Chung. It presents exhibitions, publishes books, and represents Hong Kong, Chinese, and Taiwanese artists working in contemporary art and painting. Kwai Chung is an industrial district in the New Territories.

hill-top-gallery.en: A photography-oriented gallery on the fifth floor of the Shinsaibashi Gallery Building in Minamisemba, Chuo-ku, Osaka. It holds exhibitions of photography and related work, with shows that change on a regular schedule. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
hill-top-gallery.ja: 大阪・中央区南船場の心斎橋ギャラリービル5階にある、写真を中心としたギャラリー。写真とその周辺の作品を紹介する展覧会を、定期的に入れ替えながら開催している。

hitoto.en: A gallery in Tenjinbashi 5-chome, Kita-ku, Osaka. It centres on art and photography exhibitions and live events, along with workshops and flea markets, without limiting itself to one genre. The programme changes regularly, in a neighbourhood of north Osaka.
hitoto.ja: 大阪・北区天神橋5丁目にあるギャラリー。アートや写真の展覧会とライブを中心に、ワークショップや蚤の市など、ジャンルにとらわれないイベントを開催している。

hkdi-gallery.en: HKDI Gallery is the exhibition venue of the Hong Kong Design Institute in Tseung Kwan O. It presents design shows across fields such as graphic design, architecture, fashion, product design, and multimedia, with a yearly programme tied to the institute.

hong-kong-art-school-gallery.en: The Gallery of Hong Kong Art School is an exhibition space on the 10th floor of the Hong Kong Arts Centre in Wan Chai. It presents work by the school's students and alumni, giving emerging artists gallery experience and a link to the wider art community.

hong-kong-arts-centre.en: Hong Kong Arts Centre is an arts organisation on Harbour Road in Wan Chai. It runs exhibitions, screenings, performances, and learning programmes, and supports artists, with a focus on local creativity. Its building also houses galleries on several floors, close to the Wan Chai waterfront.

hong-kong-palace-museum.en: Hong Kong Palace Museum is a museum in the West Kowloon Cultural District. It presents Chinese art and cultural heritage, including painting, ceramics, textiles, and design, through changing exhibitions and displays. The district also houses other major arts venues on the Victoria Harbour waterfront.

hosomi-museum.en: A private art museum in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku, built around a collection of roughly 1,000 works of Japanese art spanning the Jomon and Yayoi periods to Edo-period painting. It holds changing exhibitions drawn from the collection.
hosomi-museum.ja: 京都市左京区岡崎にある私立の美術館。縄文・弥生時代から江戸期の絵画まで、日本美術の約千点のコレクションを軸に、所蔵品に基づく企画展を入れ替えながら開催している。

hosoo-gallery.en: A gallery on the second floor of the HOSOO flagship store in Nakagyo-ku. It stages exhibitions that approach dyeing and weaving through art, design, crafts and science, often with outside experts. The gallery sits in central Kyoto and is devoted to textile-related work.
hosoo-gallery.ja: 中京区のHOSOO FLAGSHIP STORE 2階にあるギャラリー。染織をアート、デザイン、工芸、科学などの視点から捉える展覧会を、外部の専門家との協働で開いている。

huko.en: A gallery in a Kyoto machiya townhouse in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku. It shows contemporary art and exhibitions in a quiet setting, in a district better known for its museums, galleries and park. Its exhibitions change regularly and are open to the public.
huko.ja: 京都・岡崎の京町家にあるギャラリー。静かな空間で現代アートなどの展覧会を開いている。周辺の岡崎は、美術館やギャラリー、公園が集まる文化的なエリアである。

hyogo-prefectural-museum-of-art.en: A prefectural art museum in Chuo-ku, Kobe, on the Wakinohama waterfront, in a building designed by Tadao Ando. It presents contemporary and other art in a yearly exhibition schedule, and lies outside Osaka, in Kansai.
hyogo-prefectural-museum-of-art.ja: 神戸市中央区の脇浜海岸通にある県立美術館。安藤忠雄設計の建物で、現代アートなどを紹介し、年間を通じて展覧会を開催している。大阪市外の関西圏に位置する。

i-gallery-osaka.en: A gallery on the ground floor of the AC N Shinsaibashi Garden building in Minamisemba, Chuo-ku, Osaka. It shows a broad range of art with roots in street culture, including urban, lowbrow and pop art, and photography.
i-gallery-osaka.ja: 大阪・中央区南船場にあるギャラリー。ストリートカルチャーを起源に、アーバン、ロウブロウ、ポップアート、写真など幅広いアートを発信している。

ichion-contemporary.en: A contemporary art gallery in Nozakicho, Kita-ku, Osaka. It holds a programme of exhibitions of contemporary art. The location is in the Umeda and Tenma area north of central Osaka. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
ichion-contemporary.ja: 大阪・北区野崎町にある現代美術のギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を継続的に開催している。中心部の北側、梅田や天満に近いエリアに位置する。

imura-art.en: A contemporary art gallery based near Kawabata Marutamachi in Sakyo-ku, with a second base in Tokyo. It shows works by artists active in Japan and abroad and organises exhibitions with museums. Its programme changes regularly and is open to visitors.
imura-art.ja: 左京区の川端丸太町に拠点を置く現代美術ギャラリー。東京にも拠点がある。国内外で活動する作家の作品を紹介し、美術館との企画展も手がけている。

issey-miyake-ginza-cube.en: A gallery space linked to the ISSEY MIYAKE shop in Ginza, Chuo-ku. It hosts exhibitions and events on design, art and craft, alongside the brand's fashion presentations. Ginza is a central shopping district with department stores, boutiques and galleries.
issey-miyake-ginza-cube.ja: 中央区銀座にあるISSEY MIYAKEの店舗に併設されたギャラリー。デザイン、アート、クラフトに関する展覧会やイベントを行う。百貨店やブティックが集まる銀座の商業エリアにある。

issey-miyake-kyoto-kura.en: A space operated by the ISSEY MIYAKE brand in Nakagyo-ku, near Yanaginobanba-dori and Sanjo. It holds exhibitions and events related to textiles and design. Exhibitions change regularly, and the space is in the centre of Kyoto.
issey-miyake-kyoto-kura.ja: 中京区の柳馬場通三条付近にある、ISSEY MIYAKEが運営するスペース。テキスタイルやデザインに関わる展覧会やイベントを開いている。

issey-miyake-semba-creation-space.en: A design-oriented exhibition space in Minamisemba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, run by ISSEY MIYAKE INC. It holds exhibitions related to design and making, in a district known for its fashion and design shops. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
issey-miyake-semba-creation-space.ja: 大阪・中央区南船場にある、イッセイミヤケが運営するデザイン系の展示スペース。デザインやものづくりに関わる展覧会を開いている。ファッションやデザインの店が集まるエリアに位置する。

issey-miyake-shinjuku-shikaku.en: A small gallery on the second floor of the Isetan Shinjuku main building in Shinjuku-ku, connected to the ISSEY MIYAKE shop. It runs special projects and gallery events related to design and making, inside one of Shinjuku's best-known department stores.
issey-miyake-shinjuku-shikaku.ja: 新宿区、伊勢丹新宿本店2階にあるISSEY MIYAKEのギャラリー。デザインやものづくりに関する特別企画やイベントを開く。百貨店の売り場の中にある小さなスペース。

itsuo-art-museum.en: An art museum in Ikeda, northern Osaka Prefecture, run by the Hankyu Culture Foundation, which also operates Magnolia Hall, the Kobayashi Ichizo Memorial Museum and the Ikeda Bunko. It has no permanent display and opens its rooms during exhibitions.
itsuo-art-museum.ja: 大阪府池田市にある阪急文化財団の美術館。同財団はマグノリアホール、小林一三記念館、池田文庫も運営する。常設展示はなく、展覧会の会期中に展示室を開く。

japan-folk-crafts-museum.en: A museum at Komaba in Meguro-ku, devoted to folk crafts, or mingei. It holds special exhibitions alongside displays from its collection, in a calm district in the south-west of central Tokyo near the University of Tokyo campus.
japan-folk-crafts-museum.ja: 目黒区駒場にある、民藝をテーマにした美術館。所蔵品の展示に加え、特別展を開催する。東京大学駒場キャンパスにも近い、静かな住宅街にある。

jitsuzaisei.en: A contemporary art gallery in Oimazato, Higashinari-ku, Osaka, near Imazato Station. It is run by outsider artist Minami Miyajima and works as a juried rental space for contemporary and avant-garde art. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
jitsuzaisei.ja: 大阪・東成区大今里、今里駅近くの現代アートギャラリー。アウトサイダーアーティストのMINAMI MIYAJIMAが手がける審査制のレンタルスペースで、現代アートや創作アートを扱う。

jps-gallery-hong-kong.en: JPS Gallery Hong Kong is the Central space of a gallery that also has a location in Tokyo. On Staunton Street, it organises exhibitions of contemporary painting and pop culture themes, including shows drawing on comics.

kankakari.en: A gallery in Murasakino, Kita-ku, that shows exhibitions with a focus on ceramics. Each show presents ceramic work in a quiet residential part of northern Kyoto. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is open to visitors.
kankakari.ja: 北区紫野にある、陶芸を中心とした展覧会を開くギャラリー。京都北部の落ち着いた住宅地で、陶芸作品を紹介している。紫野は京都北部の落ち着いた地域で、展示は定期的に入れ替わる。

karimoku-commons-kyoto.en: The Kyoto location of Karimoku Commons in Nakagyo-ku, a hybrid space with office and gallery functions. Visitors can use Karimoku furniture while taking in the company's exhibitions and events. It is open to visitors and its programme changes regularly.
karimoku-commons-kyoto.ja: 中京区にあるカリモク コモンズの京都拠点。オフィスやギャラリーの機能を備え、家具を実際に使いながら展覧会やイベントに触れられる。

kayokoyuki.en: A contemporary art gallery on the second floor of the Piramide building in Roppongi, Minato-ku. It holds a regular series of exhibitions and appears at art fairs, in a building shared with other galleries in the Roppongi art district.
kayokoyuki.ja: 港区六本木のピラミデビル2階にある現代美術のギャラリー。展覧会を定期的に開催し、アートフェアにも出展する。同じビルには他のギャラリーも入る。

kcua.en: A gallery on the campus of Kyoto City University of Arts in Shimogyo-ku, near Kyoto Station. It holds a range of contemporary art exhibitions throughout the year, in a university setting. The programme changes regularly and is open to visitors.
kcua.ja: 京都駅に近い、下京区の京都市立芸術大学キャンパス内にあるギャラリー。現代美術を中心に、さまざまな展覧会を年間を通じて開催している。

kenji-taki-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, presenting a programme of exhibitions of contemporary art. It lies a short distance from the high-rise district west of Shinjuku Station, among offices and hotels. The gallery shows a changing programme through the year.
kenji-taki-gallery.ja: 新宿区西新宿にある現代美術のギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を継続的に開催する。新宿駅西側の高層ビル街に近く、オフィスやホテルが立ち並ぶエリアにある。

kiang-malingue.en: Kiang Malingue is a contemporary art gallery on Sik On Street in Wan Chai. It shows emerging and established artists, and also operates a space in New York. Sik On Street is a small street in Wan Chai, close to the neighbourhood's shops and restaurants.

ko-gei-kyoto.en: A Kyoto festival of kogei, or craft-based art, linked to the KOGEI GENE project that trains people to carry on craft techniques and values. It is based around Myokenji-mae-cho in Kamigyo-ku, with ceramics and textile among its themes.
ko-gei-kyoto.ja: 工芸を軸にした京都の芸術祭。手わざの価値を継承する人材を育てるプロジェクト「KOGEI GENE」と結びついている。拠点は上京区の妙顕寺前町で、陶芸や染織なども取り上げる。

koen-kyoto.en: A small gallery in the Ichijoji area of Sakyo-ku, Kyoto. It presents exhibitions and events in contemporary art, in a residential neighbourhood in the north-east of the city. Its exhibitions and events change regularly throughout the year.
koen-kyoto.ja: 京都市左京区一乗寺にある小さなギャラリー。現代アートの展覧会やイベントを開催している。市の北東部、住宅地の落ち着いた一角に位置する。

koji-kinutani-tenku-art-museum.en: An art museum on the 27th floor of the Umeda Sky Building Tower West in Kita-ku, Osaka, associated with the artist Koji Kinutani. It holds special exhibitions and has a cafe, in the Umeda area near Osaka Station.
koji-kinutani-tenku-art-museum.ja: 大阪・北区の梅田スカイビル タワーウエスト27階にある、画家・絹谷幸二にゆかりのある美術館。企画展を開催し、カフェも併設する。大阪駅に近い梅田エリアに位置する。

kojin.en: A gallery and salon at Kojin-guchi, one of the historic Seven Entrances to Kyoto, in Kamigyo-ku. It holds exhibitions and events of contemporary art near the Kamo River. Shows change regularly, in a quiet part of the city centre.
kojin.ja: 京都七口のひとつ荒神口にある、ギャラリー兼サロン。上京区に位置し、鴨川の近くで現代アートの展覧会やイベントを開催している。

koki-arts.en: A contemporary art gallery on the ground floor of a building in Higashi-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku. It shows one exhibition at a time, with a programme of contemporary art. Higashi-Kanda is a low-rise district of small companies and shops east of central Tokyo.
koki-arts.ja: 千代田区東神田のビル1階にある現代美術のギャラリー。展覧会を一つずつ開催し、現代美術の企画を紹介する。小さな会社や店が並ぶ、東京東部のエリアにある。

kotaro-nukaga.en: A contemporary art gallery in TERRADA Art Complex II in Higashi-Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku, in the Tennozu area. It presents exhibitions of contemporary artists, including shows connected to the gallery's other spaces. Tennozu is known for converted warehouses and galleries.
kotaro-nukaga.ja: 品川区東品川、天王洲のTERRADA Art Complex II 1階にある現代アートのギャラリー。現代美術家の展覧会を開催し、他の拠点と連携した展示も行う。倉庫を転用したギャラリーが集まる天王洲にある。

kouichi-fine-arts.en: An art gallery in Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka. It mainly handles contemporary and modern art, including not only painting but also lacquer work and pieces made with 3D printers. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is in a business district of central Osaka.
kouichi-fine-arts.ja: 大阪・西区江戸堀にあるアートギャラリー。コンテンポラリーアートやモダンアートを中心に、絵画のほか漆芸や3Dプリンターによる作品も扱っている。

kuramonzen.en: A gallery in Murasakino, Kita-ku, showing Japanese pottery, ceramics, contemporary art and antiques. It has operated since 1995 and presents works in a Kyoto setting. Murasakino is a quiet area of northern Kyoto, and exhibitions change regularly.
kuramonzen.ja: 北区紫野にあるギャラリー。日本の陶芸、現代美術、骨董を扱い、1995年から営業している。京都の落ち着いた空間で作品を紹介する。

kusakabe-gallery.en: A gallery in Kamigyo-ku, just north of Nijo Castle. It shows exhibitions across genres and is also available as a rental gallery and event space. Exhibitions change regularly, and the gallery is open to visitors throughout the year.
kusakabe-gallery.ja: 上京区、二条城の北側にあるギャラリー。ジャンルを問わず展覧会を開き、貸しギャラリーやレンタルスペースとしても使われている。

kwai-fung-hin.en: Kwai Fung Hin Art Gallery is a gallery on Queen's Road Central. It presents exhibitions of contemporary art and painting, with solo and group shows and participation in art fairs. Queen's Road Central is a main thoroughfare through the business and gallery district of Central.

kyoto-art-center.en: A municipal art centre in Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto, set up to support the arts in the city. It presents exhibitions, performances, talks and workshops, and supports artists in making and showing new work, with a focus on contemporary art.
kyoto-art-center.ja: 京都市中京区にある市立の芸術センター。展覧会、公演、トーク、ワークショップを開くほか、アーティストの制作や発表も支援しており、現代美術を中心に創造と発信の拠点となっている。

kyoto-art-month.en: A programme running in October and November that links art events and exhibitions across Kyoto. It points to participating partner venues around the city, so visitors can follow shows from one site to the next.
kyoto-art-month.ja: 10月から11月にかけて、京都市内各地のアートイベントや展覧会をつなぐ取り組み。参加する各会場への案内役となっており、複数の展示を巡って鑑賞できる。

kyoto-city-kyocera-museum-of-art.en: A municipal art museum in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku, reopened after a large renovation by architects Aoki Jun and Nishizawa Tezzo. It holds exhibitions of art in Kyoto's museum and park district. It is among several museums in the area, which also includes a park.
kyoto-city-kyocera-museum-of-art.ja: 京都市左京区岡崎にある市立美術館。青木淳と西澤徹夫の設計による大規模改修を経て再開した。美術館や公園が集まる岡崎の文化エリアで、美術の展覧会を開催している。

kyoto-experiment.en: A performing arts festival held in Kyoto city, presenting theatre, dance and other live work. Performances and related programmes take place at several venues around the city, rather than at a single central site. Its programme changes with each edition.
kyoto-experiment.ja: 京都市内で開かれる舞台芸術祭。演劇やダンスなどのライブ作品を紹介し、公演や関連企画は特定の会場に限らず、市内の複数の会場で行われる。

kyoto-modern-architecture-festival.en: A festival that opens a range of modern buildings in Kyoto to visitors at once. Programmes such as tours and talks are held at sites across the city, giving access to architecture that is not usually open.
kyoto-modern-architecture-festival.ja: 京都に現存するモダン建築を一斉に公開する催し。見学ツアーやトークなどの企画が市内各所の建築を会場に行われ、普段は入れない建物に触れる機会となっている。

kyoto-national-museum.en: A national museum in Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto, near Chaya-cho. It hosts exhibitions of art and cultural artefacts, and sits in the Higashiyama area, which is known for its temples and historic streets. Exhibitions change through the year.
kyoto-national-museum.ja: 京都市東山区の茶屋町にある国立博物館。美術や文化財を紹介する展覧会を開催している。周辺の東山エリアは、寺社や歴史ある街並みで知られる。

kyoto-youme-triennale.en: A triennial in Kyoto covering art, design and craft. Its programme brings works and events to sites across the city, so each edition is spread over several locations rather than a single gallery or museum building.
kyoto-youme-triennale.ja: アート、デザイン、工芸を横断する京都の3年ごとの芸術祭。作品や企画が市内各所で展開され、一つの美術館や画廊にとどまらず、複数の会場をめぐって鑑賞できる。

kyotoba.en: A gallery and event space in Nishinokyo, Nakagyo-ku, built around the idea of a place that welcomes free expression. It shows contemporary work in exhibitions on its gallery floor. The venue is in the western part of central Kyoto.
kyotoba.ja: 中京区西ノ京にある、自由な表現を受け入れる場としてつくられたギャラリー兼イベントスペース。ギャラリーのフロアで現代的な作品の展示を行っている。

kyotographie.en: An international photography festival held across Kyoto. Exhibitions are staged in venues around the city, with the festival organised from an office in Nakagyo-ku. Its programme brings photography into a mix of buildings and spaces in the city.
kyotographie.ja: 京都を舞台に開かれる国際写真祭。市内各所の会場で写真展を展開しており、事務局は中京区に置かれている。さまざまな建物や空間が展示の場となる。

kyotophonie.en: A music festival in Kyoto, organised from the Nakagyo-ku base it shares with KYOTOGRAPHIE. Its programme is presented through performances at venues around the city, adding a musical counterpart to the city's festival calendar. Its concerts and events change with each edition.
kyotophonie.ja: 京都の音楽祭。KYOTOGRAPHIEと同じ中京区の拠点から運営され、市内各所の会場で演奏プログラムを展開する。京都の祭典の一つとして音楽を紹介している。

leica-gallery-kyoto.en: A photography gallery operated by Leica in the Gion district of Higashiyama-ku. It shows exhibitions by photographers, usually changing every few weeks, in the historic entertainment district of Kyoto. Shows are open to visitors and focus on photography.
leica-gallery-kyoto.ja: 東山区の祇園エリアにある、ライカが運営する写真ギャラリー。写真家の個展などを紹介し、展示は定期的に入れ替わる。京都の歴史ある花街に位置する。

lurf-museum.en: A contemporary art gallery in Tokyo, also known as LURF GALLERY. It holds exhibitions of contemporary art. The programme changes regularly through the year, with a mix of solo and group shows by artists and related practitioners.
lurf-museum.ja: 東京にある現代美術ギャラリー。LURF GALLERYとしても知られ、現代アートの展覧会を開催する。アーティストなどによる展示を入れ替えながら紹介している。

m-plus.en: M+ is a museum of visual culture in the West Kowloon Cultural District. It collects, shows and interprets 20th- and 21st-century art, design, architecture, and moving image, with a focus on Hong Kong, Asia and international exchange. Exhibitions run alongside a collection-based programme.

maho-kubota-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in Tokyo that opened in 2016. It presents works by Japanese and international artists in a changing programme of exhibitions, including solo and group shows of contemporary art throughout the year.
maho-kubota-gallery.ja: 2016年に開廊した、東京の現代美術ギャラリー。国内外の作家の作品を、入れ替わりの展覧会で紹介している。個展やグループ展を通じて現代アートを紹介する。

masaki-art-museum.en: A museum in Tadaoka, Osaka Prefecture, run by a public interest foundation. Its collection includes Zen calligraphy, ink painting and tea ceremony wares, among them works designated National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties. The museum is in the southern part of Osaka Prefecture.
masaki-art-museum.ja: 大阪府忠岡町にある公益財団法人運営の美術館。禅僧の墨蹟や水墨画、茶道具などを所蔵し、国宝や重要文化財に指定された作品も含まれる。

miho-museum.en: A museum in Shigaraki, Koka, in the hills of Shiga Prefecture outside Kyoto. The building was designed by I. M. Pei, and the museum shows Egyptian, Greek, Roman and Asian art alongside Japanese art in changing exhibitions. It can be reached on a day trip from Kyoto.
miho-museum.ja: 滋賀県甲賀市信楽の山あいにある美術館。建物はI.M.ペイの設計で、古代エジプトやギリシャ・ローマ、アジアの美術と日本美術を展示している。京都から足を延ばして訪れることができる。

misako-and-rosen.en: A contemporary art gallery in Kita-Otsuka, Toshima-ku, in the Otsuka area of Tokyo. It presents a changing programme of exhibitions of contemporary art. Otsuka is a residential and commercial neighbourhood on the Yamanote line, north of the main gallery districts.
misako-and-rosen.ja: 豊島区北大塚、東京・大塚にある現代美術のギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を入れ替えながら開催する。山手線沿線の住宅と商業が混在するエリアに位置する。

mizuma-art-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in Ichigaya-Tamachi, Shinjuku-ku, on the second floor of the Kagura building. Its programme includes Tokyo exhibitions of contemporary artists, and it also has a presence in Singapore. The gallery shows both Japanese and international artists.
mizuma-art-gallery.ja: 新宿区市谷田町のカグラビル2階にある現代美術のギャラリー。東京での展覧会を開催するほか、シンガポールでも展示を行っている。国内外の作家を紹介する。

momak.en: The National Museum of Modern Art, Kyoto, in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku. It collects and preserves twentieth-century art from Japan and elsewhere, with particular attention to Kyoto artists and movements, and holds exhibitions. It is one of the museums gathered in the Okazaki cultural district.
momak.ja: 京都市左京区岡崎にある国立近代美術館。日本と海外の20世紀の美術作品を収集・保存し、京都ゆかりの作家や動向にも重点を置く。展覧会も開催している。

mori-art-museum.en: A contemporary art museum in Roppongi Hills, Minato-ku, run by Mori Building. Its programme includes a main exhibition alongside smaller series such as MAM Screen and MAM Project. Roppongi is an art district, with several other museums and galleries within walking distance.
mori-art-museum.ja: 港区六本木ヒルズにある現代美術館。森ビルが運営し、メインの展覧会に加えて、MAMスクリーンやMAMプロジェクトなどの小規模な企画も行う。周辺には美術館やギャラリーが集まる、アートの街として知られる六本木にある。

mori-yu-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in Shogoin, Sakyo-ku, representing Japanese and international artists since 2001. It also runs a viewing room in Kamigyo-ku, open by appointment. The gallery's exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors in a quiet part of eastern Kyoto.
mori-yu-gallery.ja: 左京区聖護院にある現代美術ギャラリー。2001年から国内外の作家を扱っている。上京区には予約制のビューイングルームも持つ。

mtk.en: A contemporary art gallery founded in March 2021 in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku. It focuses on artists with ties to western Japan and shows around eight exhibitions a year, in Kyoto's museum district. The gallery is close to several museums.
mtk.ja: 2021年3月に京都・岡崎で設立された現代アートのギャラリー。西日本ゆかりの作家を中心に、年に8回ほど企画展を開く。美術館が集まる岡崎エリアに位置する。

museum-of-contemporary-art-tokyo.en: A museum of contemporary art in Kiba, Koto-ku, run by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government and opened in 1995. It aims to promote contemporary art and holds special exhibitions and collection displays. Kiba is a quiet district beside Kiba Park, east of central Tokyo.
museum-of-contemporary-art-tokyo.ja: 江東区木場にある東京都の現代美術館。1995年に開館し、現代美術の振興を目的として、企画展や所蔵作品の展示を行う。木場公園に隣接する、東京東部の落ち着いたエリアにある。

museum-of-kyoto.en: A museum at Sanjo-Takakura in Nakagyo-ku, central Kyoto. It holds special exhibitions on history, culture and art, and sits in an area of the city's older downtown streets. Its exhibitions vary through the year and cover a broad range of themes.
museum-of-kyoto.ja: 京都市中京区、三条高倉にある博物館。歴史、文化、美術に関する特別展を開催している。京都中心部の旧市街にあり、古い街並みが残るエリアに位置する。

nakanoshima-kosetsu-museum.en: An art museum on the fourth floor of Nakanoshima Festival Tower West in Kita-ku, Osaka. It belongs to the Kosetsu Museum of Art foundation, whose collection of older Japanese and East Asian art was gathered by Asahi Shimbun founder Ryohei Murayama.
nakanoshima-kosetsu-museum.ja: 大阪・北区中之島のフェスティバルタワー・ウエスト4階にある美術館。朝日新聞社創業者・村山龍平が収集した日本と東アジアの古美術を所蔵する香雪美術館の分館にあたる。

nakanoshima-museum-of-art-osaka.en: An art museum on Nakanoshima in Kita-ku, Osaka, known as NAKKA. It focuses on temporary exhibitions, including Japanese art and a contemporary series called Osaka Directory, alongside its collection and learning programmes. Nakanoshima is Osaka's river island, home to several museums.
nakanoshima-museum-of-art-osaka.ja: 大阪・北区中之島にある美術館「NAKKA」。日本美術や、現代作家を紹介する「Osaka Directory」などの企画展を中心に、コレクションの展示や教育普及活動も行っている。

nanzuka.en: A contemporary art gallery in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. It holds exhibitions of Japanese and international artists working in contemporary art. Shibuya is a major commercial and cultural district in western Tokyo, with a changing mix of galleries and venues.
nanzuka.ja: 渋谷区にある現代美術ギャラリー。国内外の現代美術の作家の展覧会を開催する。個展やグループ展を通じて、入れ替わりの企画を一年を通して紹介している。渋谷は東京西部の商業・文化の中心地として知られる。

national-art-center-tokyo.en: An art venue in Roppongi, Minato-ku, opened in 2007. It hosts large special exhibitions and open-call shows such as the annual Nitten, rather than keeping a permanent collection. Roppongi is an art district, with the Mori Art Museum and Suntory Museum of Art close by.
national-art-center-tokyo.ja: 港区六本木にある2007年開館のアートセンター。所蔵コレクションは持たず、大規模な企画展や日展などの公募展を開催する。森美術館やサントリー美術館も近く、美術館が集まる六本木のエリアにある。

national-museum-of-art-osaka.en: A national art museum on Nakanoshima in Kita-ku, Osaka, known as NMOA. It organises exhibitions and maintains a collection, with research and learning programmes, on the river island that is home to several museums. Exhibitions change regularly.
national-museum-of-art-osaka.ja: 大阪・北区中之島にある国立の美術館。展覧会の開催とコレクションの収集・研究、教育普及活動を行っている。複数の美術館が集まる、川に囲まれた中之島に位置する。

national-museum-of-modern-art-tokyo.en: A national museum of modern art near Kitanomaru Park in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It presents special exhibitions and collection displays of modern and contemporary art. The museum stands close to the Imperial Palace grounds, in a central, green part of the city.
national-museum-of-modern-art-tokyo.ja: 千代田区の北の丸公園周辺にある国立の近代美術館。近現代美術の企画展と所蔵作品の展示を行う。皇居にも近い、都心の緑豊かなエリアに位置する。

new-pure-plus.en: A shop and gallery space in Awajimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, near Kitahama. It combines a select shop on the ground floor with an alternative space in the basement, and reopened here in 2015 after earlier locations in Minamisemba and Nakanoshima.
new-pure-plus.ja: 大阪・中央区淡路町（北浜）にあるセレクトショップとギャラリーの複合空間。1階がセレクトショップ、地下1階がオルタナティブスペース。以前は南船場と中之島にあり、2015年に現在地で再オープンした。

nonaka-hill.en: A contemporary art gallery with a space on Shinmonzen-dori, Higashiyama-ku, in Kyoto's antique and art dealer district. It presents exhibitions of contemporary artists, with a focus on Japan. Exhibitions change regularly throughout the year, and the area is easy to explore on foot.
nonaka-hill.ja: 東山区の新門前通にある現代美術ギャラリー。骨董や美術商が並ぶ一帯に位置し、日本に焦点を当てた現代作家の展覧会を開いている。

oi-art-space.en: Oi! is an art space on Oil Street in North Point, run by the Art Promotion Office. It hosts exhibitions and public programmes of contemporary art and design in a former Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club building by the harbour.

one-a-space.en: 1a space is an independent, non-profit contemporary art space at Cattle Depot Artist Village in To Kwa Wan. It was established in 1998 by local arts practitioners and focuses on exhibitions, events, publications, and community-oriented art projects.

ora-ora.en: Ora-Ora is a contemporary art gallery based in the Barrack Block at Tai Kwun in Central. It presents multidisciplinary exhibitions spanning digital art, installation, sculpture, ink, and mixed media by artists from Hong Kong, mainland China, and abroad.

osaka-geidai-whatsnew.en: Osaka University of Arts is a comprehensive arts university with a campus in Kanan-cho, Minamikawachi-gun, in southeastern Osaka Prefecture. Art and exhibition events connected with the university take place on and around the campus. Exhibitions and events change through the year.
osaka-geidai-whatsnew.ja: 大阪府南河内郡河南町にキャンパスを置く総合芸術大学。大学に関わるアートや展覧会のイベントが、キャンパスやその周辺で開かれている。

osaka-nihon-mingeikan.en: A folk crafts museum in Senri Expo Park, Suita, run by a public interest foundation. It keeps a collection of folk crafts and holds seasonal special exhibitions, a folk craft market and a shop. Special exhibitions change with the seasons.
osaka-nihon-mingeikan.ja: 吹田市の万博記念公園内にある民藝の美術館。民藝の収蔵品を持ち、季節ごとの特別展や「みんげい市」を開催する。ショップも併設している。

osaka-ukiyoe-museum.en: A museum dedicated to ukiyo-e woodblock prints and paintings, on the third floor of the Fujiya Shinsaibashi Building in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It holds special exhibitions and has a museum shop. Shinsaibashi is a busy shopping and entertainment area of central Osaka.
osaka-ukiyoe-museum.ja: 大阪・中央区の藤屋心斎橋ビル3階にある、浮世絵を専門とする美術館。特別展を開催し、ミュージアムショップも併設している。浮世絵の版画や肉筆画を展示し、心斎橋の繁華街に位置する。

oscaar-mouligne.en: A contemporary art exhibition space in Murasakino, Kita-ku, in a pavilion-like building. Founded in November 2023, it presents exhibitions by international artists. Murasakino is a quiet area of northern Kyoto, and exhibitions change regularly, so each visit offers something new.
oscaar-mouligne.ja: 北区紫野にある、パビリオンのような建物の現代美術展示スペース。2023年11月に開設され、海外の作家を含む展覧会を開いている。

ota-fine-arts.en: A contemporary art gallery with several locations, including a space in Tokyo. It holds exhibitions of Japanese and international artists working in contemporary art. The Tokyo space presents a changing programme of solo and group shows through the year.
ota-fine-arts.ja: 東京にもスペースを持つ、複数拠点の現代美術ギャラリー。国内外の現代美術の作家の展覧会を開催する。東京のスペースでは、個展やグループ展を通じて入れ替わりの企画を紹介している。

oyamazaki-villa-museum.en: A museum in Oyamazaki, just outside Kyoto city, set in the nature of the area. It holds special exhibitions and talks in a hillside setting to the south-west of the city. Exhibitions change through the year and are open to visitors.
oyamazaki-villa-museum.ja: 京都市の南西、大山崎町の自然の中にある美術館。特別展やトークイベントを開催している。市街地の外に位置し、山あいの落ち着いた環境にある。

para-site.en: Para Site is an independent contemporary art space on the 22nd floor of an industrial building in Quarry Bay. It works with local and international artists and curators on exhibitions and new projects, with an emphasis on critical, research-led contemporary art.

parcel-tokyo.en: A gallery that opened in 2019 on the ground floor of DDD HOTEL in Nihonbashi-Bakurocho, Chuo-ku. The former multi-storey car park combines features of a project space and a gallery, with a contemporary art programme that crosses various cultures and values.
parcel-tokyo.ja: 2019年、中央区日本橋馬喰町のDDD HOTEL内に開廊したギャラリー。元は立体駐車場だった空間で、プロジェクトスペースとギャラリーの特徴を併せ持ち、現代美術を軸にさまざまな文化や価値観を横断する企画を行う。

parco-hall-shinsaibashi.en: An event hall on the 14th floor of Shinsaibashi PARCO in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It is a space for themed projects spanning art, design, culture and fashion, within a large shopping building in Shinsaibashi. Exhibitions and events change regularly.
parco-hall-shinsaibashi.ja: 大阪・中央区の心斎橋PARCO 14階にあるイベントホール。アート、デザイン、カルチャー、ファッションにわたる企画を発信するスペースで、心斎橋の商業ビル内に位置する。

perrotin-tokyo.en: The Tokyo space of Perrotin, an international contemporary art gallery, located in Roppongi, Minato-ku. It holds a changing programme of exhibitions of contemporary artists. Roppongi is an art district, with several galleries and museums close by.
perrotin-tokyo.ja: 国際的な現代美術ギャラリー、ペロタンの東京スペース。港区六本木にあり、現代美術家の展覧会を開催する。周辺にはギャラリーや美術館が多く、アートの街として知られるエリアにある。

play-museum.en: An art museum in the Green Springs complex in Tachikawa, western Tokyo. It is built around the theme of pictures and words, with exhibitions for adults and children alike, and sits alongside PLAY! PARK, an indoor play space for children.
play-museum.ja: 東京都立川市のGREEN SPRINGS内にある美術館。「絵とことば」をテーマに、大人も子どもも楽しめる展覧会を開く。子どものための屋内広場PLAY! PARKと並ぶ複合文化施設の一部。

plus-y-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery on the third floor of the Otemae Kensetsu Kaikan building in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It is a curating gallery that represents a list of named artists and holds planned exhibitions through the year.
plus-y-gallery.ja: 大阪・中央区谷町の大手前建設会館内にある現代美術の企画ギャラリー。取扱作家を擁し、年間を通じて企画展を開催している。展示は定期的に入れ替わり、現代作家の作品に触れられる。

pmq.en: PMQ is a creative and design hub on Aberdeen Street in Central. It brings together design studios, shops, and event spaces, and hosts exhibitions, events, and workshops focused on design and contemporary creative work. The hub sits in the hillside streets of Central's SoHo area.

pola-museum-annex.en: An exhibition space on the third floor of the Pola Ginza building in Ginza, Chuo-ku. It shows art exhibitions with a programme that changes through the year. Ginza is a central shopping district with department stores, boutiques and many other galleries.
pola-museum-annex.ja: 中央区銀座、ポーラ銀座ビル3階にある展示スペース。入れ替わる美術展を開催する。百貨店やブティック、ギャラリーが集まる銀座の中心部にある。

purple-purple.en: A space on the third floor of a building in Nakagyo-ku that combines books, exhibitions and events. It focuses on photography and acts as a meeting point for new forms of expression. It is open to visitors and its programme changes regularly.
purple-purple.ja: 中京区のビル3階にある、本と展示とイベントが重なり合う空間。写真を中心に展覧会を開き、新しい表現と出会う場となっている。

raku-museum.en: A museum in Kamigyo-ku devoted to Raku ware, founded in 1978 next to the Raku family home. Its collection centres on works by successive generations of the Raku family, tea ceremony crafts and family documents.
raku-museum.ja: 上京区にある楽焼の美術館。1978年に楽家に隣接して設立された。所蔵品は歴代の楽家の作品や茶道工芸、楽家に伝わる文書資料が中心となっている。

rossi-and-rossi.en: Rossi & Rossi is a gallery with separate contemporary and classical programmes. Its Hong Kong exhibitions include early Himalayan works as well as shows by younger Tibetan contemporary artists, alongside other contemporary presentations. The gallery is part of an international programme of exhibitions.

samac.en: A museum in Saga-Arashiyama, Ukyo-ku, focused on art and culture connected with the area. It displays Hyakunin Isshu material and Nihonga in a 120-tatami hall, and runs changing exhibitions. It is in a scenic area popular with visitors.
samac.ja: 右京区の嵯峨嵐山にある、土地にゆかりのある芸術と文化を紹介するミュージアム。百人一首の展示や、120畳の大広間の日本画があり、企画展も開かれる。

scai-park.en: A contemporary art gallery in the TERRADA Art Complex in Higashi Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku. It is one of the SCAI spaces and holds exhibitions of contemporary artists. The surrounding Tennozu waterfront area is known for its converted warehouses and galleries.
scai-park.ja: 品川区東品川のTERRADA Art Complexにある現代美術ギャラリー。SCAIのスペースの一つで、現代美術家の展覧会を開く。周辺の天王洲エリアは、倉庫を転用したギャラリーが集まる場所として知られる。

scai-piramide.en: A contemporary art gallery on the third floor of the Piramide building in Roppongi, Minato-ku. It is one of the SCAI spaces and holds exhibitions of contemporary artists. Roppongi is an art district, with several galleries and museums located close together.
scai-piramide.ja: 港区六本木のピラミデビル3階にある現代美術ギャラリー。SCAIのスペースの一つで、現代美術家の展覧会を開く。ギャラリーや美術館が集まる、アートの街として知られる六本木にある。

scai-the-bathhouse.en: A contemporary art gallery in Yanaka, Taito-ku, in a former bathhouse building near Nezu and Ueno. It holds exhibitions of contemporary artists. Yanaka is an older, low-rise neighbourhood of temples, small shops and narrow streets.
scai-the-bathhouse.ja: 台東区谷中にある、銭湯だった建物を使った現代美術ギャラリー。現代美術家の展覧会を開催している。寺院や小さな店が並ぶ、根津や上野に近い昔ながらの落ち着いた街並みにある。

sen-oku-hakukokan.en: A museum in Shishigatani, Sakyo-ku, that preserves, studies and exhibits art including the Sumitomo collection. It is the Kyoto branch of a museum with two locations, the other being in Roppongi, Tokyo. It stands in the quiet Shishigatani area on the eastern side of Kyoto.
sen-oku-hakukokan.ja: 左京区鹿ヶ谷にある美術館。住友コレクションをはじめとする美術品を保存・研究・公開している。東京・六本木にも館を持つ二館体制の京都館にあたる。

setagaya-art-museum.en: A public art museum in the green setting of Kinuta Park in Setagaya-ku. Alongside its exhibitions it has a library, a restaurant and a cafe. Kinuta Park is a large park in the west of the city, and the museum sits within its grounds.
setagaya-art-museum.ja: 世田谷区の緑豊かな砧公園内にある公立の美術館。展覧会のほか、ライブラリーやレストラン、カフェも備える。都内西部の大きな公園の敷地内にあり、散策と合わせて訪れやすい。

shibunkaku.en: An art dealer and publisher with a gallery in Motomachi, Higashiyama-ku. It sells art and classical books, runs exhibitions and publishes, working to carry on Japanese culture. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors in the Higashiyama area.
shibunkaku.ja: 東山区元町に画廊を構える、美術品や古典籍の販売、出版を行う思文閣。展覧会も開き、日本文化の継承と普及に取り組んでいる。画廊は東山エリアにあり、展示は定期的に入れ替わる。

sho-plus-1.en: A contemporary art gallery in Ueno, Taito-ku, which opened in 2021. It presents exhibitions of contemporary art and also shows work at art fairs outside Tokyo. Ueno is a district known for its park and museum cluster, as well as busy shopping streets.
sho-plus-1.ja: 2021年に台東区上野で開廊した現代アートのギャラリー。現代美術の展覧会を開くほか、東京以外のアートフェアにも出展している。公園や博物館・美術館で知られる上野にある。

shugoarts.en: A contemporary art gallery in the complex665 building in Roppongi, Minato-ku, founded in Tokyo in 2000. It aims to build close collaborations with artists and presents their exhibitions. It also runs an appointment-only studio in Tennozu.
shugoarts.ja: 港区六本木のcomplex665内にある現代アートのギャラリー。2000年に東京で創設され、アーティストとの深い協働を掲げて展覧会を開催する。天王洲には予約制のスタジオも運営している。

sibasi.en: A cafe in Okazaki, Sakyo-ku, with a focus on music. It hosts live performances and occasional exhibitions alongside its everyday cafe use, in Kyoto's museum and park district. It is a relaxed place to see live music or a small show over a drink.
sibasi.ja: 京都市左京区岡崎にあるカフェ。音楽を軸に、ライブや展示を折々に開催している。日常のカフェとしても使われ、美術館や公園が集まる岡崎エリアに位置する。

sin-sin-fine-art.en: Sin Sin Fine Art is a gallery in an industrial building in Wong Chuk Hang. It presents exhibitions of contemporary art and painting, with a programme of solo and group shows. Wong Chuk Hang is a former industrial district on Hong Kong Island, now home to many galleries.

sokyo-kyoto.en: A gallery in Higashiyama-ku representing artists in and outside Japan. It works with contemporary ceramics, lacquer, textiles, glass and metal, and presents them through changing exhibitions of craft-based art. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
sokyo-kyoto.ja: 東山区にあるギャラリー。国内外の作家を扱い、現代の陶芸、漆、染織、ガラス、金属の作品を紹介している。工芸を軸にした展覧会を入れ替えながら開催する。

soluna-fine-art.en: Soluna Fine Art is a gallery on Sai Street in Sheung Wan that specialises in Asian contemporary art. It is part of the Soluna group, which also includes a space in Seoul. Sheung Wan is a Hong Kong Island neighbourhood with a concentration of galleries.

standing-pine-tokyo.en: A contemporary art gallery on the third floor of TERRADA ART COMPLEX I in Higashi-Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku. It presents a changing programme of exhibitions. The building sits in the Tennozu waterfront area, known for converted warehouses and a cluster of galleries.
standing-pine-tokyo.ja: 品川区東品川、寺田倉庫のTERRADA ART COMPLEX I 3階にある現代アートのギャラリー。展覧会を入れ替えながら開催する。倉庫を転用した画廊が集まる天王洲の水辺のエリアに位置する。

suchsize.en: A gallery in Sanno, Nishinari-ku, Osaka. It shows art exhibitions, with changing displays of contemporary work in a neighbourhood in the south-west of the city. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors in an area south of central Osaka.
suchsize.ja: 大阪・西成区山王にあるギャラリー。美術展を開催しており、展示は入れ替わりで紹介される。市の南西部の街なかに位置する。現代美術を中心に、展示は定期的に入れ替わる。

sumida-hokusai-museum.en: A museum at Kamezawa in Sumida-ku, dedicated to Katsushika Hokusai. It aims to be a base for local exchange, linking art and craft connected to the artist with the surrounding neighbourhood. Sumida-ku is the ward where Hokusai was born, east of the Sumida River.
sumida-hokusai-museum.ja: 墨田区亀沢にある、葛飾北斎を紹介する美術館。北斎につながるアートやものづくりを通じて、まちでの交流を生み出す拠点を目指している。北斎が生まれた墨田区の、両国に近いエリアにある。

taka-ishii-gallery.en: The Kyoto space of Taka Ishii Gallery, located in Yada-cho, Shimogyo-ku. It presents exhibitions of contemporary art and photography, and forms part of a gallery that also operates spaces elsewhere. Shows change regularly and are open to visitors.
taka-ishii-gallery.ja: タカ・イシイギャラリーの京都のスペース。下京区矢田町にあり、現代アートや写真の展覧会を開催している。同ギャラリーは他の都市にも展示スペースを構えている。

taka-ishii-gallery-tokyo.en: The Roppongi space of Taka Ishii Gallery, on the third floor of the complex665 building in Minato-ku. The gallery also has other Tokyo spaces, and some exhibitions are shown across more than one location. Roppongi is an art district with many galleries.
taka-ishii-gallery-tokyo.ja: 港区六本木のcomplex665 3階にあるタカ・イシイギャラリーの六本木スペース。ギャラリーは東京に他の拠点も持ち、展覧会が複数の会場にまたがることもある。

take-ninagawa.en: A contemporary art gallery in Higashi-Azabu, Minato-ku, established in 2008. It presents exhibitions by the artists it represents, including Japanese and international names. Higashi-Azabu is a quiet area of Minato-ku close to Roppongi and Akabanebashi.
take-ninagawa.ja: 港区東麻布にある、2008年設立の現代美術ギャラリー。所属する国内外の作家の展覧会を開催する。六本木や赤羽橋に近い、港区の落ち着いたエリアにある。

takeo-exhibitions.en: An exhibition programme by TAKEO, a specialist paper distributor, held at Yodoyabashi MIHONCHO in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It shows paper and design exhibitions, including the TAKEO PAPER SHOW. Exhibitions change regularly, and the venue is in a central business district of Osaka.
takeo-exhibitions.ja: 紙の専門商社・竹尾による展示で、大阪・中央区の淀屋橋ミホンチョーで開催される。紙やデザインをテーマにした展覧会やTAKEO PAPER SHOWを行っている。

takuro-someya-contemporary-art.en: A contemporary art gallery on the third floor of TERRADA Art Complex I in Higashi-Shinagawa, Shinagawa-ku, in the Tennozu area. It presents exhibitions of contemporary artists, in a waterfront district known for converted warehouses and galleries.
takuro-someya-contemporary-art.ja: 品川区東品川、天王洲のTERRADA Art Complex I 3階にある現代アートのギャラリー。現代美術家の展覧会を開催する。倉庫を転用したギャラリーが集まる天王洲の水辺のエリアにある。

taro-nasu-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery on the fourth floor of the Piramide building in Roppongi, Minato-ku. It presents solo and group exhibitions by Japanese and international artists, in a building shared with several other galleries. Roppongi is an art district.
taro-nasu-gallery.ja: 港区六本木のピラミデビル4階にある現代美術のギャラリー。国内外のアーティストによる個展やグループ展を開く。同じビルには複数のギャラリーが入る、アートの街・六本木にある。

taro-okamoto-memorial-museum.en: A museum in Minami-Aoyama, Minato-ku, set in the studio where Taro Okamoto lived and worked for 42 years. It displays tools and works from that time, with special exhibitions in the upstairs room. The studio stands in a residential part of Aoyama.
taro-okamoto-memorial-museum.ja: 港区南青山にある、岡本太郎が42年間住み、制作を続けたアトリエを公開する記念館。当時の道具や作品を展示し、2階では企画展も開く。青山の住宅街に位置する。

tezukayama-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka. It focuses on young and mid-career Japanese artists, presenting them through exhibitions and art fairs, including overseas. Exhibitions change regularly, and the area is known for its cafes and small shops.
tezukayama-gallery.ja: 大阪・西区南堀江の現代美術ギャラリー。国内の若手から中堅のアーティストを中心に、企画展や海外を含むアートフェアを通じて作品を発信している。

the-terminal-kyoto.en: A space in Shimogyo-ku set in a restored traditional Kyoto machiya townhouse. It hosts exhibitions, events and workshops, and is conceived as a place where knowledge, craft and community gather. The building preserves a traditional style of Kyoto architecture.
the-terminal-kyoto.ja: 下京区にある、京町家を復元した空間。展覧会やイベント、ワークショップを開き、知恵や技術、人が集まる場として運営されている。

tokyo-gallery-btap.en: A contemporary art gallery on the seventh floor of a building in Ginza, Chuo-ku, run together with Beijing Tokyo Art Projects. Its exhibitions cover shows in both Tokyo and Beijing. Ginza is a central shopping district with many other galleries nearby.
tokyo-gallery-btap.ja: 中央区銀座のビル7階にある現代アートのギャラリー。北京の姉妹拠点BTAPと連携して運営され、東京と北京の展覧会を紹介する。ギャラリーが多い銀座にある。

tokyo-metropolitan-art-museum.en: A museum in Ueno Park, Taito-ku, Tokyo. It hosts a range of special exhibitions and group shows throughout the year. Ueno Park is home to a cluster of museums, including the national and science museums, and the zoo, all within walking distance of one another.
tokyo-metropolitan-art-museum.ja: 台東区上野公園内にある美術館。年間を通じてさまざまな企画展や公募展を開催する。上野公園には博物館や美術館が集まっており、徒歩圏内で複数の展示施設を巡ることができる。

tokyo-node.en: A cultural complex on the upper floors of Toranomon Hills Station Tower in Minato-ku. It combines an event hall, gallery, restaurant and rooftop garden, and hosts art, design, performance and mixed cultural events. Toranomon is a business district near Kasumigaseki and Shimbashi.
tokyo-node.ja: 港区虎ノ門、虎ノ門ヒルズ ステーションタワーの高層部にある複合施設。イベントホール、ギャラリー、レストラン、屋上ガーデンなどを備え、アートやデザイン、パフォーマンスなど多彩な催しを行う。

tokyo-opera-city-art-gallery.en: A gallery within the Tokyo Opera City cultural complex, at Nishi-Shinjuku in Hatsudai, Shinjuku-ku. The complex also contains concert halls, and the gallery holds regular art exhibitions. It is located a short distance west of Shinjuku's main business district.
tokyo-opera-city-art-gallery.ja: 新宿区西新宿・初台の複合文化施設、東京オペラシティ内にあるギャラリー。施設にはコンサートホールも併設され、ギャラリーでは定期的に展覧会を開催する。新宿の中心部から西に少し離れたエリアにある。

tokyo-photographic-art-museum.en: A museum devoted to photography and moving images, located at Yebisu Garden Place in the Ebisu area of Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. It holds exhibitions of photographers and photographic work. The garden complex also includes shops and restaurants.
tokyo-photographic-art-museum.ja: 恵比寿ガーデンプレイスにある、写真と映像を専門とする美術館。写真家や写真作品を紹介する展覧会を開く。ショップやレストランも入る複合施設の一角にある。

tomio-koyama-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery in the complex665 building in Roppongi, Minato-ku. The gallery also runs spaces in Kyobashi and Tennozu, and its exhibitions are held at one or more of these locations. Roppongi is an art district with many galleries.
tomio-koyama-gallery.ja: 港区六本木のcomplex665内にある現代アートのギャラリー。京橋や天王洲にも拠点を持ち、展覧会はこれらの会場で開催される。ギャラリーが多い六本木にある。

university-art-museum-tokyo-geidai.en: A university museum of Tokyo University of the Arts, located near Ueno Park in Taito-ku. It holds exhibitions of art and related work from the university. The museum stands close to the museum cluster of Ueno Park and the university's campus.
university-art-museum-tokyo-geidai.ja: 台東区上野公園周辺にある、東京藝術大学の大学美術館。大学ゆかりの美術作品の展覧会を開催する。上野公園の美術館群にも近いエリアにある。

videotage.en: Videotage is a media arts organisation based at Cattle Depot Artist Village in To Kwa Wan. It presents video and media art through exhibitions, screenings, online programmes, and symposiums. The village is a cluster of artist studios and arts organisations in a former government cattle depot.

villepin.en: Villepin is a gallery with spaces in Hong Kong and Milan. The Hong Kong space is on Hollywood Road in Central and presents exhibitions of art and design, representing artists and designers. Hollywood Road is a street known for galleries and antique shops.

wa-gallery-osaka.en: A contemporary art gallery in the Shinsaibashi area of Osaka. It centres on the work of washi paper artist Wataru Hata, under a theme of things in Japan worth preserving, and presents changing exhibitions. Exhibitions change regularly.
wa-gallery-osaka.ja: 大阪・心斎橋にあるコンテンポラリーアートギャラリー。和紙作家ハタノワタルの作品を中心に、日本の残すべきものをテーマとして、展覧会を開催している。

what-museum.en: A museum run by Terrada Warehouse in Tennozu, Shinagawa-ku. It shows contemporary art, including works kept in storage, in exhibitions held in a warehouse setting. Tennozu is a waterfront area known for converted warehouses, galleries and cafes.
what-museum.ja: 品川区天王洲にある、寺田倉庫が運営する美術館。倉庫に保管された現代アートなどを、倉庫空間を生かした展覧会として公開している。天王洲は、倉庫を転用したギャラリーやカフェが並ぶ水辺のエリア。

white-cube-hong-kong.en: White Cube Hong Kong is a contemporary art gallery at Connaught Road Central, part of an international gallery with several locations. It presents solo and group exhibitions of established and emerging artists in Central, the city's main commercial gallery district.

whitestone-gallery-hong-kong.en: Whitestone Gallery Hong Kong is the city space of an art gallery with locations across East Asia. It occupies the 7th floor of M Place in Wong Chuk Hang and presents exhibitions of contemporary artists, including Japanese and Asian painters.

yamatane-museum-of-art.en: A museum in Hiroo, Shibuya-ku, devoted to Japanese-style painting, or nihonga. It moved to its current site in 2009 and stages several exhibitions a year from its collection and elsewhere. Hiroo is a calm, residential neighbourhood close to Ebisu and Roppongi.
yamatane-museum-of-art.ja: 渋谷区広尾にある日本画専門の美術館。2009年に現在地へ移転し、所蔵作品などを紹介する展覧会を年に数回開く。恵比寿や六本木にも近い、落ち着いた住宅街の広尾にある。

yayoi-kusama-museum.en: A museum in Bentencho, Shinjuku-ku, founded by the artist Yayoi Kusama and opened in 2017. It presents her works in themed exhibitions held in a small, multi-storey building. Entry is by reservation, with timed admission.
yayoi-kusama-museum.ja: 新宿区弁天町にある、草間彌生が創設した美術館。2017年開館。小規模な建物の中で、作品をテーマ別の展覧会として紹介する。入館は日時指定の予約制。

yod-gallery.en: A small contemporary art gallery in Nishitenma, Kita-ku, Osaka. It holds a changing programme of exhibitions, with current and upcoming shows. The area lies close to the Tenma and Nakanoshima districts. Exhibitions change regularly, so there is usually a new show to see.
yod-gallery.ja: 大阪・北区西天満にある、現代美術を中心とした小さなギャラリー。展覧会を入れ替えながら開催している。天満や中之島に近いエリアに位置する。

yoshiaki-inoue-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery on the second and third floors of the Shinsaibashi Inoue Building in Chuo-ku, Osaka. It holds exhibitions of contemporary art, in the Shinsaibashi district in the centre of the city. Exhibitions change regularly.
yoshiaki-inoue-gallery.ja: 大阪・中央区心斎橋筋の心斎橋井上ビル2・3階にある現代美術のギャラリー。市の中心部、心斎橋エリアで現代美術の展覧会を開催している。

yoshimi-arts.en: A gallery in Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka, near Higobashi. It introduces artists and works with an independent view of art, without following trends, and shows exhibitions in both Osaka and Tokyo. Exhibitions change regularly and are open to visitors.
yoshimi-arts.ja: 大阪・西区江戸堀（肥後橋）にあるギャラリー。流行や時代性にとらわれず、独自の芸術観・世界観を持つ作家や作品を紹介している。大阪と東京の両方で展覧会を開く。

yutaka-kikutake-gallery.en: A contemporary art gallery on the second floor of the Piramide building in Roppongi, Minato-ku, opened in 2015. It supports artists working with new forms of expression. Roppongi is an art district, with several galleries and museums within walking distance.
yutaka-kikutake-gallery.ja: 港区六本木のピラミデビル2階にある現代美術ギャラリー。2015年に開廊し、新しい表現に取り組むアーティストの活動を支える。ギャラリーや美術館が集まる六本木にある。

zenbi.en: A museum in Gion, Higashiyama-ku, run by the Kyoto confectioner Kagizen Yoshifusa. Exhibitions centre on its collection of works by Kuroda Tatsuaki, alongside other fine art and craft, in the historic Gion district. The museum is open to visitors and shows changing exhibitions.
zenbi.ja: 東山区祇園にある、京菓子の鍵善良房による美術館。黒田辰秋の作品を中心とするコレクションを軸に、ほかの美術工芸も紹介する企画展を開く。歴史ある祇園の街中に位置する。
